messages.dx.tutorial.title: Equipment lesson
messages.dx.tutorial.intro: Compare → equip → salvage → enchant → equip again. You confirm every action and can return to quests at any time.
messages.dx.tutorial.phase.claim: Collect practice gear from a smith
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.quest: Finish and turn in your first quest before starting this lesson.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.skill: Your quest reward skill book is still in your bag. Learn it to make the next fights easier.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.claim: Visit a smith for a one-time practice package. No cube is needed.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.compared: Read the full cards for your candidate and current weapon. A usable blue weapon with a high main stat for your class is selected by default. You can choose another.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.equipped: Equip the weapon you compared. Blue means Magic quality; the benefit depends on its affixes and your class.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.salvaged: Keep your selected main weapon and preview salvaging another usable blue weapon. Check the input before confirming.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.enchanted: Enchanting accepts gear in your bag, so remove your weapon first. Spend one Magic Essence and gold to randomly replace an affix. The result may be weaker.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.reequipped: Enchanting does not equip the weapon. Equip a blue weapon with an enchantment lock, then continue your adventure.
messages.dx.tutorial.hint.done: You know the equipment loop. Use the Darkforged Workshop for salvage, enchanting, runes and cube recipes.
messages.dx.tutorial.package: One-time package: two item-level 1 blue Wooden Swords with +2 / +1 to your class main stat, plus 300 gold. This covers one 300-gold practice enchantment. It cannot be claimed again.
messages.dx.tutorial.done: Turn spare blue gear into essence, then spend it on an appropriate affix. Check required levels on future drops: Reduced Level Requirement lets you equip high-level gear early.
messages.dx.tutorial.learnSkill: Learn the skill book in your bag
messages.dx.tutorial.compare: Confirm comparison and choose this weapon
messages.dx.tutorial.salvageSafe: Salvaging permanently consumes gear. The lesson only preselects another usable blue weapon from your bag, preferring the lowest main stat for your class. It never confirms automatically. Check it again.
messages.dx.tutorial.removeEnchant: Remove weapon and choose an affix
messages.dx.tutorial.enchantCost: Cost: 1 Magic Essence + {{gold}} gold. Your first confirmation permanently locks the chosen affix slot. Later enchantments can only reroll that slot.
messages.dx.tutorial.needSpace: Your bag is full. Free one slot before removing the weapon.
messages.dx.tutorial.needSpare: No spare usable blue weapon. Continue your adventure and return with another one. The practice package cannot be claimed again.
messages.dx.tutorial.needEssence: You need Magic Essence. Salvage spare blue gear at a smith first.
messages.dx.tutorial.needGold: You need {{gold}} gold. Continue questing and return to finish enchanting.
messages.dx.tutorial.needWeapon: No usable blue weapon. Continue questing and return through the workshop when you find one.
messages.dx.tutorial.needEnchanted: Choose an enchanted blue weapon. Its affix slot shows a lock.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.unavailable: The equipment lesson is unavailable in this game mode.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.quest: Turn in your first quest first.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.smith: Collect the package beside a smith who provides salvaging.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.space: Free two bag slots first. The package has not been claimed.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.target: Choose a blue weapon in your bag that you can equip now.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.unclaimed: Collect the practice package from a smith first.
messages.dx.tutorial.error.gold: Your gold exceeds the saveable range. The package cannot be claimed yet.
messages.dx.tutorial.granted: Received two blue practice Wooden Swords and 300 gold. Open the equipment lesson to compare them.
